experiments.title: Target encoding with inner OOF
experiments.hypothesis: High-cardinality categories can be encoded without leaking the validation target.
experiments.risk: Leakage if fitted outside the fold; kconv uses inner OOF and smoothing.
experiments.notes: Implemented in FeatureBuilder; enable via features.target_encode or auto_encode.

experiments.title: Frequency encoding instead of one-hot
experiments.hypothesis: Rare categories are better represented by their frequency than by thousands of dummy columns.
experiments.risk: Frequency can leak if computed on train+test; kconv fits it per fold.
experiments.notes: Implemented as <column>__freq in FeatureBuilder.

experiments.title: Rank-average blending
experiments.hypothesis: Rank averaging is more robust than raw probability averaging when model scales differ.
experiments.risk: Can erase calibrated probabilities; only use for ranking metrics or as a blend candidate.
experiments.notes: Implemented as ensemble.method=rank_mean.

experiments.title: Out-of-fold stacking with a meta-model
experiments.hypothesis: A simple meta-model over OOF predictions can exploit complementary model errors.
experiments.risk: Meta-model must use OOF only; otherwise the stack is leaky.
experiments.notes: Implemented as ensemble.method=stack with logreg/ridge/lgbm meta-model.

experiments.title: Seed averaging
experiments.hypothesis: Averaging several seeds reduces variance of tree/MLP predictions.
experiments.risk: Does not fix a bad validation split; multiplies runtime.
experiments.notes: Implemented as ModelConfig.seeds; profile 3-5 uses 2-3 seeds.

experiments.title: Group-aware cross-validation
experiments.hypothesis: Rows sharing a group must stay in one fold, otherwise CV is optimistic.
experiments.risk: Wrong group column can make folds too small or unrepresentative.
experiments.notes: Implemented as validation.strategy=group_kfold with group_col.

experiments.title: Time-ordered validation with a gap
experiments.hypothesis: A gap between train and validation prevents leakage from lagged or near-duplicate rows.
experiments.risk: A large gap reduces training data; test different gaps.
experiments.notes: Implemented as validation.strategy=time_series with gap.

experiments.title: Text metadata features
experiments.hypothesis: Length and word count of text fields carry useful signal even without a language model.
experiments.risk: Can encode dataset artifacts; validate on a time/group split.
experiments.notes: Implemented as <column>__len and <column>__words for text role columns.

experiments.title: Adversarial train/test validation
experiments.hypothesis: If a classifier can separate train from test, the validation distribution is suspect.
experiments.risk: High AUC can be caused by legitimate new categories; inspect importances.
experiments.notes: Implemented as 01_validate/adversarial.json; does not automatically change CV.

experiments.title: Pseudo-labeling confident test rows
experiments.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test predictions to training can improve a strong model.
experiments.risk: Confirmation bias and leakage; must be evaluated with a clean holdout.
experiments.notes: Not implemented. Requires confidence thresholds, multiple rounds and ablation.

experiments.title: Targeted feature crosses
experiments.hypothesis: A small number of domain-driven crosses can beat hundreds of automatic interactions.
experiments.risk: Explosion of cardinality and overfitting; select by CV, not by train score.
experiments.notes: Not implemented. Candidate for a whitelist-based cross builder.

experiments.title: Row-wise statistics
experiments.hypothesis: Mean/std/min/max across numeric columns can capture relative row profiles.
experiments.risk: Scales differ; normalize or use rank-based variants.
experiments.notes: Implemented in FeatureBuilder and the dptools/row-features recipe; enable via features.row_statistics. Benchmark: a local benchmark report (not committed).

experiments.title: Adversarial sample weighting
experiments.hypothesis: Down-weight training rows that look like test rows only if the validation split confirms the shift.
experiments.risk: Can amplify noise; never tune weights on the public leaderboard.
experiments.notes: Not implemented. Must be compared with an unweighted baseline on a fixed split.

experiments.title: LLM-proposed additional features
experiments.hypothesis: An LLM can propose a small, validated set of domain-aware feature expressions from schema and samples.
experiments.risk: Hallucinated columns, target leakage, privacy leakage, non-determinism.
experiments.notes: See docs/llm-features.md. LLM output is JSON proposals only; no eval/exec.

experiments.title: Multi-seed snapshot ensemble
experiments.hypothesis: Checkpoints from different seeds/epochs can add diversity beyond final-model averaging.
experiments.risk: Large disk usage and correlated snapshots; validate diversity first.
experiments.notes: Not implemented. More relevant to neural models than GBDT.

experiments.title: Class-conditional kNN distance features
experiments.hypothesis: Per-class distances to the nearest neighbours of that class encode local class geometry that axis-aligned trees cannot build.
experiments.risk: Label-conditioned neighbour search must run inside each outer fold; full-matrix fitting leaks labels.
experiments.notes: Implemented in kconv.features.knn with fit-in-fold OOF, bounded reference sets and a classification-only guard; enable via features.knn_features.

experiments.title: Gaussian rank normalization
experiments.hypothesis: Rank-to-normal mapping removes skew and outliers without assuming a parametric distribution, helping scale-sensitive and distance-based models.
experiments.risk: The source ranks train and test jointly; kconv fits the reference distribution on the train fold only.
experiments.notes: UP-03: prototype in kconv.features.unusual.GaussianRankTransformer; benchmark and fold-safe transform are in a local benchmark report (not committed).

experiments.title: Modulo and multi-resolution decomposition
experiments.hypothesis: An integer that mixes coarse buckets and a fine residual is hard for axis-aligned trees; x % m and x // step expose both views.
experiments.risk: Modulo features can memorize individuals; accept only on a fixed split and never use as an identity feature.
experiments.notes: Implemented in FeatureBuilder behind features.modulo_features; opt-in because it should only be applied to identifier-like columns. Benchmark: a local benchmark report (not committed).

experiments.title: Dense cross-fit target encoding
experiments.hypothesis: More inner folds shrink the gap between train-time and inference-time target encodings, reducing encoder overfit on high-cardinality columns.
experiments.risk: The encoder must stay inside the outer fold; scikit-learn TargetEncoder semantics changed across versions.
experiments.notes: UP-15: candidate for an inner-CV parameter on FeatureBuilder's target encoder.

experiments.title: Risk-adjusted cross-fitted effect encoding
experiments.hypothesis: Estimating per-value effects around a fold-fitted mechanism margin captures conditional signal that a plain mean target encoder misses.
experiments.risk: Effects are fitted on labels; without inner cross-fitting this is a direct label encoder.
experiments.notes: UP-17: highest-ceiling feature family in the triage, but needs a dedicated cross-fit harness first.

experiments.title: Label-free pooled frequency features
experiments.hypothesis: Category frequencies estimated on pooled unlabelled train+test rows can be a better prior than train-only frequencies for distribution-shifted test data.
experiments.risk: Transductive: the pipeline depends on the test set and some competitions forbid it; labels must never be pooled.
experiments.notes: UP-19: opt-in only; current FeatureBuilder frequency encoding is fit on the training fold.

experiments.title: Offset boosting with a fold-trained baseline
experiments.hypothesis: Using a domain-mechanism prior as the booster's base margin lets trees model only the residual around a physically sensible baseline.
experiments.risk: The baseline must be refit per fold and the offset columns removed from the booster features.
experiments.notes: UP-21: top triage candidate, but needs adapter-level base_margin support for each booster.

experiments.title: Tabular foundation model baseline
experiments.hypothesis: A pretrained tabular foundation model on raw columns can beat a tuned GBDT on small/medium tables and is a diverse blend member.
experiments.license: NO LICENSE — ideas only; model terms must be checked
experiments.risk: Model weights have non-commercial/version terms; context limits and non-reproducible releases are real blockers.
experiments.notes: UP-23: no code vendored; explicit model-license and GPU review required before integration.

experiments.title: Conditional permutation importance within strata
experiments.hypothesis: Permuting a feature only within correlated strata isolates its contribution better than global permutation importance.
experiments.risk: Still an approximate diagnostic, not a causal effect or an independent holdout.
experiments.notes: UP-35: implement as a report/diagnostic, not as a model-selection signal.

experiments.title: Label-free covariate-retention audit
experiments.hypothesis: Train-to-test covariate copying can be detected without labels by comparing unique-row column matches against a within-bin permutation null.
experiments.risk: A failed null does not prove absence of leakage; the procedure may read sensitive external data.
experiments.notes: UP-36: correctness gate candidate; report-only, never a feature or automatic decision.
